title: PAGLANTAW: Envisioning the Future Through Python
summary: PyCon Davao 2026, Davao's community-run Python conference.
description: The second full-scale PyCon Davao brings together Python developers, students, educators, and technology communities. The main conference is on October 17, followed by sprints and workshops on October 18.

registration.instructions: The main conference is October 17; sprints and workshops are October 18. Sprint Day admission is separate from conference admission. Review the individual ticket descriptions; the overall date range does not establish ticket coverage.
